We are an industrial automation company specializing in robotic palletizers, case packers,
end-of-line automation and custom machinery. We are building a reusable machine vision
platform, and this OCR project is Phase 1.

Develop a robust OCR application for NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano using a camera to read
printed alphanumeric characters. The architecture should be modular and reusable for
future barcode, QR, AI inspection and robot guidance applications.

 NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano Developer Kit

 C-Mount Lens

Camera Integration
 Acquire live images
 Control resolution/frame rate
 Capture on demand

 Cropping
 Rotation correction
 Perspective correction
 Brightness/contrast
 Noise removal
 Thresholding
 ROI selection
OCR Engine
 Read batch numbers

 Serial numbers

 Robust to rotation, lighting and blur

 Processing logs

 Camera configuration
 Test dataset
 Sample results
 Deployment support
Acceptance Criteria
 Runs on Jetson Orin Nano
 Reliable OCR under controlled lighting

 Near real-time processing
 Modular architecture
Future Opportunities
Successful completion may lead to follow-on projects in barcode reading, AI inspection,
robot guidance, PLC communication and multi-camera vision.
Proposal Requirements
 Relevant experience
 OCR references
 Jetson/OpenCV experience
 Timeline
 Commercial quotation
 Portfolio/GitHub

Summary

# Migration & Security Handover Brief
**Prepared for:** MetaNet

---

## 1. Summary of what I need

I want to migrate my web estate from Exoscale to MetaNet **and** perform a security
clean-up at the same time, following a parting of ways with the previous contractor
who built and had administrative access to these systems. I am not technical, so I
need this handled end-to-end, but with **ownership of all accounts remaining under my
control** (see section 3).

Please treat this as: (a) a **clean migration** of 17 sites, and (b) a **security
hardening / access reset** so no prior access survives the move.
---

## 2. The estate

- **2 dynamic sites:** RedMontMed ([login to view URL]) and RedMontActive
([login to view URL]) — near-identical builds. **No traditional database**; their
search is powered **live by the Anthropic (Claude) API** over the internet.
- **15 static sites:** (I can move there") all domains are already registered with MetaNet. 
- **Payments:** Stripe is used on RedmontMed and RedmontActive.
on an Exoscale instance or
handled entirely by Brevo. This needs to be established before DNS is changed. We could, of course, just set up emails on the MetaNet service?
- **Current hosting:** Exoscale, spread across multiple zones
(hr-zag-1, ch-dk-2, de-fra-1, de-muc-1, at-vie-1). Security group `b02fd963-…`
currently has inbound ports 25, 465, 587, 993, 995 open to 0.0.0.0/0.

---

## 3. Ground rule: I keep ownership of the accounts

Please configure and operate within these accounts, but they must be registered under
**my** email/login with **my** payment card, and access I grant you should be under
**your own named logins** (not shared passwords), to be revoked when work completes:

- Domain / DNS for all sites
- Stripe
- Anthropic (Claude) API account
- The new MetaNet hosting account

If any of these are currently registered under the previous contractor's login rather
than mine, please flag it — transferring or recreating them under my control is part of
the job.

---

## 4. Migration requirements

1. **Clean rebuild, not a raw clone.** Please build fresh server environments and move
only my website files and data across — do **not** image/clone the existing Exoscale
servers, so that no leftover SSH keys, extra user accounts, or scheduled tasks are
carried over.
2. I can do the 15 static sites first (quick wins), then MetaNet does the two dynamic sites
carefully.
3. **DNS:** plan cut-overs to minimise downtime and account for propagation time.
4. **Test before cut-over** for every site — confirm each loads and functions before
pointing its domain at MetaNet.
5. **Decommission the old Exoscale resources only after** everything is confirmed
working on MetaNet (this also stops the Exoscale billing).
---

## 5. Per-service checklist

**Anthropic (Claude) API — powers search on the two dynamic sites**
- Confirm the Anthropic account/organisation is under my control; check its billing and
which card is attached.
- Rotate the API key **during** migration in safe order: create a new key → update the
site code → test search works → then revoke the old key (no search downtime).
- If the account is the contractor's, create a **new** Anthropic organisation under my
email/card and point both sites at a fresh key from it.

**Stripe — payments**
- Verify the payout **bank account** on file is mine and unchanged.
- Rotate the API key in safe order (new key → update site → test a live payment →
revoke old).
- Remove any dashboard access held by the previous contractor.

**Firewall (Exoscale, pre-move)**
- The five inbound mail rules (ports 25/465/587/993/995, source 0.0.0.0/0) on security
group `b02fd963-…` should be reviewed against the email finding above and tightened or
removed as appropriate.

**Servers**
- Audit the server for unknown SSH keys, unknown user accounts, and unknown
scheduled tasks (cron) before decommissioning.
- Set fresh root/admin passwords on the new servers.

---
## 6. Evidence to preserve before decommissioning

Before any old Exoscale server is deleted, please **pull and provide the server login
logs** (`/var/log/[login to view URL]` or `/var/log/secure`), and note website file-modification
dates and any Git history. I need these to reconcile a billing/hours matter with the
previous contractor. This is time-sensitive — please capture it before anything is wiped.

---
## 7. Compliance

RedMontMed / RedMontActive are Swiss and medical in nature. Please ensure the migration and data handling meet Swiss data-
protection expectations (data location, secure transfer, access control). The sites hold no personal information save for email addresses. 

---
## 8. What I'd like back from you

1. A short **discovery** step to inspect the current setup and answer
the open questions above , and are the
Anthropic/Stripe/domain accounts under my control?
2. Following discovery, a **fixed written estimate** (cost and timescale) for the full
migration + security clean-up.
3. Confirmation of how you'll keep me as the account owner throughout.

Please raise anything unclear with me directly rather than assuming. Thank you.

full_description:
JKBOSE AI — Freelancer Project Brief

Project Overview

We are looking for an experienced Full-Stack Mobile App + AI Developer to build JKBOSE AI, an AI-powered learning platform for Jammu & Kashmir students following the JKBOSE curriculum.

Initial classes: 8th–12th.

This must **not** be a simple PDF/book app. The goal is to make studying easier through:

**READ → UNDERSTAND → ASK AI → PRACTICE → TEST → FIND WEAKNESS → REVISE → MASTER** 

No Teacher Dashboard or School Dashboard.** A separate **Super Admin Panel** is required.

---

1. Student App

Build a modern **Android-first, mobile-friendly app**.

Navigation:

Home | Learn | Practice | AI Tutor | Profile**

Student Login

* Mobile OTP
* Email/password
* Forgot password
* Profile setup
* Class selection
* Subjects
* Preferred language
* Study goal

Languages:

* English
* Hindi
* Roman Urdu

Do not collect unnecessary personal information. 

2. Student Dashboard

Show:

* Student name
* Class
* Study streak
* Today's study plan
* Overall progress
* Subject progress
* Weak subject
* Recommended chapter
* Continue Learning
* Quick Practice
* AI Tutor


 3. Chapter-Wise Learning

Content structure:

**JKBOSE → Class → Subject → Book → Chapter → Topic → Lesson**

Each chapter should provide:

1. Understand
2. Learn
3. Watch
4. Ask AI
5. Practice
6. Test
7. Revise
8. Board Questions

Break large chapters into **short micro-lessons** instead of long pages of text. 

---

4. AI Tutor — Main USP

Create a syllabus-aware **JKBOSE AI Tutor**.

AI should understand:

**Class + Subject + Book + Chapter + Topic + Language**

Use **RAG** with authorized/curated educational content.

AI modes:

* Explain Simply
* Hindi
* Roman Urdu
* Give Example
* Step-by-Step
* Ask Me Questions
* Generate MCQs
* Summarize
* Quick Revision

Add an **“I Don't Understand”** button that explains the same concept using simpler language, examples or diagrams. 

The AI should teach rather than simply provide answers:

**Explain → Identify concept → Method → Step-by-step → Similar question → Check student answer.** 

5. AI Photo + Voice

Photo Question Solver

Student can upload/take a photo.

AI should:

* Read question
* Identify subject/topic
* Explain
* Solve step-by-step
* Use simple language
* Generate similar practice question

Voice AI

Support:

* Voice input
* Text input
* Text-to-speech

---

6. MCQ & Test System

MCQ difficulty:

Easy | Medium | Hard

Options:

**10 | 20 | 30 questions**

Show explanations immediately and track score, accuracy and weak topics.

Tests:

* Chapter Test
* Subject Test
* Full Syllabus Test
* Mock Board Exam

Results should show:

* Score
* Accuracy
* Time
* Correct/wrong answers
* Weak topics
* Revision recommendation. 

7. Personalized AI Learning

The system must analyze student performance.

Example:

**Mathematics — 72%**

Weak:

* Algebra — 45%
* Geometry — 51%

Strong:

* Statistics — 88%
* Probability — 91%

AI automatically recommends:

**“Revise Algebra for 15 minutes today.”**

Recommendations should use test performance, weak topics, completed chapters, study history and available study time. 

Include:

* Weak topics
* Incorrect questions
* Saved questions
* Flashcards
* Formulas
* Quick revision
* 30-day study plan
* Exam Tomorrow mode
* Board preparation/PYQs. 

---

# 8. Offline Mode

Allow students to download legally available:

* Notes
* Lessons
* MCQs
* Tests
* Flashcards
* Videos where permitted

Downloaded content should work offline. AI can remain online initially. 

---

# 9. Super Admin Panel

**No Teacher/School Dashboard.**

Admin modules:

* Dashboard
* Students
* Boards
* Classes
* Subjects
* Books
* Chapters
* Topics
* Lessons
* Videos
* MCQs
* Tests
* AI Knowledge
* AI Reports
* Subscriptions
* Payments
* Notifications
* Admin Users
* Audit Logs
* Settings

Dashboard must show real database statistics:

**Total Students | Active Students | New Students | Premium Students | Classes | Subjects | Chapters | MCQs | Tests | AI Questions | Revenue**

Also provide analytics for student growth, retention, popular subjects, chapters, scores and AI usage. 

---

# 10. Content & AI Management

Admin must be able to create/edit/publish:

**Board → Class → Subject → Book → Chapter → Topic → Lesson**

Content types:

* Notes
* Text
* PDF
* Video
* Audio
* Images
* Diagrams
* MCQs
* Questions
* Board questions
* Flashcards

AI pipeline:

**Source → Text Extraction → Chunking → Embedding → Vector DB → RAG → AI Response**

Admin should see processing and publishing status. 

---

# 11. Subscription

### FREE

* Limited content
* Limited AI
* Daily MCQs
* Basic tests

### PREMIUM

* Full content
* AI Tutor
* Advanced tests
* Board preparation
* Personalized study plan
* Revision engine
* Advanced analytics
* Offline content

Admin-configurable:

**Monthly | Quarterly | Yearly | Coupon | Trial | Renewal**

---

# 12. Technology

Preferred:

* **Flutter or React Native**
* **Supabase/PostgreSQL**
* **LLM API + RAG**
* **pgvector**
* **Supabase Storage**
* **React/[login to view URL] Admin Panel**

Use proper authentication, RLS, role-based permissions, secure backend/Edge Functions and audit logs. AI API keys must never be exposed in the frontend. 

---

# 13. MVP

Do **not** build all classes initially.

### Phase 1

**Class 10 → Mathematics → 3 Chapters**

Include:

Login → Learning → Micro-lessons → AI Tutor → MCQs → Chapter Test → Progress → Revision → Admin Content Management. 

Then:

**Phase 2:** Remaining Class 10 subjects
**Phase 3:** Class 12
**Phase 4:** Classes 8, 9 & 11

Architecture must be board-independent so it can later expand to other Indian boards. 

---

# 14. Freelancer Deliverables

Developer must provide:

* Complete source code
* Android app/APK/AAB
* Admin panel
* Supabase/backend
* Database schema
* AI/RAG
* Authentication
* API documentation
* GitHub repository
* Deployment documentation
* Full project ownership handover
* Bug-fixing/support period

All source code, database, domain, AI configuration and project accounts must remain under **client ownership**. 

---

# 15. Freelancer Must Provide

Please send:

1. 2–3 relevant AI/mobile projects
2. Demo/links
3. Recommended technology stack
4. Development timeline
5. **Fixed price for Phase-1 MVP**
6. Price for complete Class 8–12 version
7. AI/RAG cost
8. Monthly server/API cost
9. Maintenance cost
10. Source-code ownership confirmation
11. Account ownership confirmation
12. Play Store deployment timeline

**Do not send a generic proposal.**

Explain specifically how you will build:

**JKBOSE → Class → Subject → Chapter → Topic → AI Tutor → MCQ → Test → Weakness → Revision**
More information : 77→80→82→98→45
and how the architecture will scale to other Indian education boards.

Low-Code BPM Governance & Approval Workflow POC – Professional Enterprise UI

We are looking for an experienced BPM / BPMS / Low-Code developer to build a Proof of Concept for a Governance & Approval Workflow Platform.

The core workflow is:

Submission → EXO Review → Committee Review → Board Review → Decision → Minutes Verification → Audit

We are specifically looking for a solution that can deliver as much functionality as possible through an existing low-code/BPMS platform, with minimal custom development.

PLATFORM

We are open to platforms such as:

- Joget
- Bonita
- Flowable
- ProcessMaker
- Other suitable open-source or self-hosted BPMS platforms

You should recommend the platform you believe is best suited for this requirement and explain why.

MANDATORY UI MOCKUP BEFORE SELECTION

Before awarding the project, shortlisted freelancers must provide a small functional UI mockup/prototype based on this requirement.

The mockup should demonstrate:

- Login
- Executive dashboard
- Submission screen
- Review/approval screen
- Agenda and meeting screen
- Board decision screen
- Minutes verification screen

The UI must look like a professional enterprise product suitable for executives and senior management.

Generic Bootstrap/CRUD templates will not be considered sufficient.

Please provide screenshots or links to previous enterprise applications you have designed/built.

CORE FUNCTIONALITY

The POC should demonstrate:

- Role-based login and access
- Submission creation and tracking
- Unique submission/reference number
- EXO/Coordinator review
- Return for revision
- Committee review
- Board review
- Approve / Reject / Hold
- Mandatory remarks for Hold/Reject
- Resubmission with version history
- Agenda preparation and consolidation
- Meeting association
- Meeting scheduling
- Meeting minutes upload and verification
- Decision recording
- Complete audit trail
- Search and filtering
- Basic reporting
- Notifications
- Document attachments

MICROSOFT TEAMS

The eventual solution will integrate with Microsoft Teams / Microsoft Graph for:

- Meeting creation
- Calendar invitations
- Meeting association
- Post-meeting recap/information

For the POC, mocked Teams/Graph integration is acceptable.

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

Experience with the following is preferred:

- BPMN 2.0
- Low-code BPMS
- Joget / Bonita / Flowable / ProcessMaker
- Java / Spring Boot
- PostgreSQL
- REST APIs
- Docker
- Microsoft Graph / Teams
- SAML / OIDC
- RBAC
- Enterprise audit trails
- On-premises deployment

DELIVERABLES

1. Recommended platform and architecture
2. Professional UI mockup/prototype
3. Working POC
4. BPMN workflows
5. Database/data model
6. Role-based access
7. Audit trail
8. Document handling
9. Mock Teams/Graph integration
10. Automated tests
11. Docker-based deployment
12. Setup documentation
13. Complete source code

IMPORTANT

This is not simply a coding assignment.

We want a developer who can determine how much of the requirement can be delivered through configuration of an existing BPMS/low-code platform versus custom development.

The goal is to minimize custom development while still delivering a professional, scalable solution.

SCREENING QUESTIONS

1. Which BPM/BPMS/low-code platforms have you worked with?
2. Which of Joget, Bonita, Flowable or ProcessMaker have you implemented professionally?
3. Please provide examples/screenshots of professional enterprise UIs you have built.
4. Have you implemented multi-level approval workflows using BPMN?
5. Have you integrated Microsoft Teams/Microsoft Graph?
6. Have you implemented SAML/OIDC and RBAC?
7. Can your proposed solution run on-premises using Docker?
8. Which platform would you recommend for this project and why?
9. Approximately what percentage of the requirements can be delivered through configuration versus custom development?
10. What is your estimated timeline and fixed price for the POC?

BUDGET

Please provide a fixed-price proposal for the POC, broken into milestones.

We are evaluating platform expertise, workflow capability, UI quality and ability to minimize custom development — not simply the lowest price.
